WITH hand_counts AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(p.bats, '') AS batting_hand,
           COUNT(*) AS award_count
    FROM player_award AS pa
    JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = pa.player_id
    GROUP BY COALESCE(p.bats, '')
),
shares AS (
    SELECT batting_hand,
           award_count,
           1.0 * award_count / SUM(award_count) OVER () AS share
    FROM hand_counts
),
averaged AS (
    SELECT batting_hand,
           award_count,
           share,
           AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share
    FROM shares
)
SELECT batting_hand,
       award_count,
       share,
       share - average_share AS above_average
FROM averaged
WHERE share > average_share;
